title: Eleanor “Nana” Whitaker
subtitle: 1938 to 2026. Mother, grandmother, pie champion.
tribute_html:
Nana believed every problem could be improved by pie, and most of them could be solved by it.

She taught three generations to make biscuits by feel, to write thank-you notes, and to never leave a party without saying goodbye to the host.

She is survived by her daughters Carol and Ruth, six grandchildren, and a recipe box that will outlive us all.
